title: B2B Email List Building: How to Get Contacts for Any Campaign?

facts.fact: The article 'How to Get Contacts for a Cold Email Campaign?' was published on 2023-09-25.
The AeroLeads email finder tool lets users access nearly 15 data points, according to the article.
facts.quote: the tool allows you to access nearly 15 data points including:

facts.fact: According to the article, AnyMail Finder follows pattern matching with a 70% matching rate.
facts.quote: The tool follows pattern matching, with a 70% matching rate.

facts.fact: The article states that AnyMail Finder can whip up 100% verified email lists in just a few minutes, a claim the article attributes to the tool.
facts.quote: can whip up 100% verified email lists in just a few minutes.

facts.fact: The article says AnyMail Finder lets users verify unlimited email addresses before sending emails.
facts.quote: AnyMail Finder also lets you verify unlimited email addresses before sending emails.

facts.fact: According to an Ahrefs study published in 2021 (as cited by the page), VoilaNorbert has a 92% success rate.

facts.fact: Snov.io states that users can find 260+ million email addresses by entering a company's domain name or company name.
facts.quote: The tool also allows you to find 260+ million email addresses by simply entering the company's domain name or even company name.

facts.fact: AnyMail Finder's usage credits do not carry over to the next month, so users may pay for credits they do not need.
facts.quote: The usage credits don’t get carried over to the next month, implying that in order to keep using that data, you need to pay even when it might not be required.

facts.fact: Snov.io's unused credits do not roll over to the next month.
facts.quote: Unused credits don’t get rolled over to the next month – which could be expensive for some users.
